root_cause: Initial temporary encoder read only stdin; unchanged seed script passes the SQL filename as an argument.
wrapper:
jq() {
  if [ "$1" = "-Rs" ] && [ "$2" = "{query: .}" ]; then
    /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps({"query":open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8").read() if len(sys.argv)>1 else sys.stdin.read()}))' "${@:3}"
  else
    /usr/bin/jq "$@"
  fi
}
export -f jq
